title: aglaia meridionalis
intro: Aglaia meridionalis, commonly known as the Southern Aglaia or Philippine Aglaia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Meliaceae. It is native to the Philippines and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as its potential to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a promising natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia meridionalis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
